title: Gemini 3.8 brings prompt-designed voices to text-to-speech
friendlyTitle: Gemini can create and direct custom voices
summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS for custom voice design, line-by-line performance direction and high-volume generation across more than 100 languages and dialects. The release includes consent checks for voice replication, SynthID watermarking and C2PA credentials.
friendlySummary: Google’s new speech models can make voices from written descriptions and control how each line sounds. They support many languages and include tools to mark AI-made audio.
whyItMatters: Creators and businesses can produce narration, dubbing and voice-agent audio with finer control and fewer recording steps. The consent and provenance controls are equally important as synthetic voices become easier to make and scale.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can make podcasts, audiobooks, games and voice assistants easier to produce. Clear consent and labels help reduce misuse.
